component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 15 root.createChild("ContentNode").title = "I" + i.toStr() end for grid = m.top.findNode("grid") grid.content = root grid.observeField("itemFocused", "onFocused") mlist = m.top.findNode("mlist") mlist.content = root mlist.observeField("itemFocused", "onFocused") labels = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 7 labels.createChild("ContentNode").title = "Item " + i.toStr() end for llist = m.top.findNode("llist") llist.content = labels llist.observeField("itemFocused", "onFocused") end sub
sub onStyle() m.top.findNode("grid").visible = false node = m.top.findNode(m.top.node) node.vertFocusAnimationStyle = m.top.style node.visible = true m.top.findNode("caption").text = node.subtype() + " vertFocusAnimationStyle = " + m.top.style node.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onFocused() print "PROBE|itemFocused=" + m.top.findNode(m.top.node).itemFocused.toStr() end sub
